notes: No CraftData or AnimalData assets exist: crafting fields live on ItemData / ConstructionData / PlantData (CraftData is the shared base class); animals are ItemData entries that point at CharacterData.
Craft cost is a flat array of item GUIDs; duplicates encode the count (there is no count field).
PlantData carries no craft cost; planting uses the seed ItemData.plant_data reference, so plants are not craft recipes.
All 141 item icon GUIDs resolve to Assets/FarmingEngine/Sprites/Icons/*.png through their .meta files.
UE FItemDef has no stack-size field, so original inventory_max cannot be compared.
One dangling GUID: barn and house list craft_requirements 91a4afcd... which has no .meta anywhere under Assets (deleted asset); it is emitted as ??91a4afcd in this file.
